raw: Agent Name: Planner, Step Number: 2, Reason for Mistake: Misapplied the sign convention after the chute opened—since downward was defined positive, the velocity remains positive (still downward) while acceleration becomes negative (upward drag). The Planner instead claimed velocity became negative and acceleration stayed positive, leading to the wrong option.
